data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'kana', meaning 'to be', 'to exist'. The name Kaniz signifies the existence of God's grace and beauty in a person. It is a name evoking feelings of elegance and refinement. The name Kaniz carries the meaning “Grace, beauty, or elegance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kaniz usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, beauty, or elegance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
